title: Inventory: Albert et al. 2018 (eLife 7:e35471) supplementary bundle
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/albert2018/raw/`: the 36 files of `elife-35471-supp-v1.zip`,
downloaded from cdn.elifesciences.org and unpacked so that no single file approaches GitHub's 100 MB limit.
The zip itself is not kept; its size, SHA-256 and URL are in `sources/albert2018/SOURCE_ZIP.tsv`.
Three members are themselves zips (Source data 1, 3, 10); they are kept untouched and inventoried by member list only.
File roles are the captions on the article's figures page (saved as `extracted/figures_page.html`) or, where that page gives none, the article text.
The article page is `sources/albert2018/article.html`. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.

roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_1.zip: Source data 1 (zip of SI_Data_01_expressionValues.txt, 97 MB unpacked): log2(TPM) expression for 5,720 genes in 1,012 segregants (figures-page caption: 'Expression values'). Inventoried by member list only; not copied to docs/.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_10.zip: Source data 10 (zip of allGOResults4paper_171009.txt, 51 MB unpacked, 1.07 million rows): all GO enrichment results per hotspot and direction (described in the article text). Member list only.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_11.xlsx: Source data 11: all transcription-factor binding-site enrichment results per hotspot and direction (article text). Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_12.xlsx: Source data 12: GO enrichment for genes physically located in hotspot regions. Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_13.xlsx: Source data 13: comparison with pQTLs (Albert et al. 2014b). Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_14.xlsx: Source data 14: eQTL-eQTL interactions (full 2D scan: 387; marginal scan: 784; between additive eQTL: 1,464) with a legend sheet. Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_2.xlsx: Source data 2: experimental batch and growth (OD) covariates for all 1,012 segregants.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_3.zip: Source data 3 (zip of SI_Data_03_genotypes.txt, 107 MB unpacked): genotypes of 1,012 segregants at 42,052 markers; caption: BY (reference) allele = -1, RM allele = 1. Member list only; not copied to docs/.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_4.xlsx: Source data 4: all 36,498 detected eQTL (gene, peak marker, r, LOD, 1.5-LOD CI markers, local/cis flag, variance explained). Core input; drawn on demand.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_5.xlsx: Source data 5: additive (and additive + pairwise interaction) heritability estimates per gene. Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_6.xlsx: Source data 6: gene features used for the heritability comparisons. Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_7.xlsx: Source data 7: data for allele-specific expression vs local eQTL comparisons. Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_8.xlsx: Source data 8: overview of the 102 eQTL hotspots (bootstrap peak and 95% interval, genes in interval, eQTL and genes affected, GO and TFBS enrichments), with a legend sheet. Core input.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Source_data_9.xlsx: Source data 9: hotspot effect matrix, estimated effects of all 102 hotspots on 5,629 genes. Kept verbatim in its own lazy file.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_1.do: Supplementary file 1: multiple regression of heritability on gene features.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_10.d: Supplementary file 10: strong pQTLs without eQTL.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_2.do: Supplementary file 2: allele-specific expression comparison table (cited with Supplementary files 3 and 4 in the ASE results).
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_3.do: Supplementary file 3: allele-specific expression comparison table.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_4.do: Supplementary file 4: allele-specific expression comparison table.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_5.pd: Supplementary file 5: hotspot region plots, one page per hotspot (figure only).
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_6.pd: Supplementary file 6: gene networks of the strongest target genes of each hotspot (figure only).
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_7.do: Supplementary file 7: multiple logistic regression of genes located in hotspots on gene features.
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_8.do: Supplementary file 8: strong eQTLs without pQTL (positive values = higher expression in RM).
roles.elife_poa_e35471_Supplementary_file_9.do: Supplementary file 9: strong mRNA and protein QTLs with opposite effect.

missing: No genome-wide LOD scans; eQTL are reported as peak marker, LOD and 1.5-LOD interval only.
No LOD or effect size per hotspot in a table: hotspots are given as bootstrap peak and 95% bootstrap interval with gene and eQTL counts.
The 11,530-marker collapsed map is not given as a list; Source data 3 holds all 42,052 markers.

Inner zips: Source_data_1.zip = SI_Data_01_expressionValues.txt (1,012 segregants x 5,720 genes); Source_data_3.zip = SI_Data_03_genotypes.txt (1,012 x 42,052 markers); Source_data_10.zip = allGOResults4paper_171009.txt (1,071,000 rows) plus a __MACOSX resource fork.
